configuration.corridor: top row and rightmost column stay open; all maps have a route
configuration.timing: search perf_counter_ns including reconstruction, excluding validation and serialization
configuration.run_order: alternate dijkstra/astar order each repetition and case
configuration.tie_order: priority f, heuristic h, insertion serial; neighbors up/right/down/left

limitations: Original synthetic grids with a reserved corridor; real navigation not evaluated.
Five repeated timings measure this process and machine; other workloads may behave differently.
A* is not guaranteed faster. heap_peak counts raw queue entries, including stale entries.
